This approves appearance only: it is not a landing, activation, merge, tag or release authorisation.
decision_log.how_recorded: Said after the comparison sheet and the two native captures of the same frame were shown in the session. The decision binds the revision those captures were rendered from; every hash below was re-derived from disk when this record was written. It is a judgement of the picture, not a technical sign-off: what the pixel measurement can and cannot see is written down in artifacts/s06_alliance_batch_review/b5-asteroid-v5/report.json (limits and controls), not in this entry.
